# V11I evidence index

- `attempt-ledger.md`: immutable failure and supersession history.
- `implementation-review.md`: implementer evidence and claim boundary.
- `test-disposition.md`: existing-test KEEP/REBIND audit for the V11I
  verification/tooling semantic delta.
- `attempt-10-validation.md`: exact selected hashes and positive/negative checker
  command results.
- `attempt-11-validation.md`: corrected targeted checker sensitivity and current
  selected hashes.
- `final-review-v2-result.md`: independent bounded APPROVE, blocker=0.

  that found the immutable attempt-9 lane6 field and incorrect plusarg wording.
- `final-review-v4-checker-test-gap.md`: independent sensitivity GAP for the
  missing-focused-define negative test.
- `final-review-v5-result.md`: final independent bounded APPROVE, blocker=0.
- `final-review-render-v2.txt`: validated isolated-review dispatch input.
- `subagent-contracts/v11i-terminal-lifecycle-final-review-v2.json`: validated
